title: Common definitions (v0)
description: Shared primitive types referenced by every v0 entity and message. See docs/spec/ for the design these encode.

did.description: Decentralized Identifier. Identity is network-independent (docs/platform-architecture/03 §3), which is why it lives in the stable core.

money.description: An amount in minor units (paise, cents) to avoid floating-point money.

amount_minor.description: Amount in the smallest currency unit (e.g. paise for INR).

region.description: A coarse geographic identifier used as (part of) a grouping key. Coarse by design (docs/spec/01 §P3): a city/region name or a geohash/H3 cell prefix, never a precise point.

geoPoint.description: A precise point. NEVER a grouping key (too fine); used only inside constraints/preferences/evidence.

signature.description: A detached signature over the containing object, by the acting agent's key. Makes commitments/mandates non-repudiable (docs/spec/01 §P8 audit trail).

key_id.description: The DID key reference that produced this signature.
